title: Quasi-polynomial DAHA representation on a Weyl orbit with admissible orbit character
source_version: Official SIGMA 21 (2025) journal PDF and native TeX; acquired 2026-09-30; exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: Nonintegral orbit exponents require an induced-module quotient with stabilizer-character constraints. The author computes the affine-generator action through reduced-word/cocycle coefficients, proves kernel stability, and matches parity-dependent divided-difference terms including the nonreduced root case; abstract induction of a representation alone does not yield the displayed action.
author: Jasper Stokman
